ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Stillsand
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
STILLSAND_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 — RimMandrake tier standalone build of the Extreme Desert biome (Phase A row 1 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md; parent BIOME_MOD_SPLIT_EXECUTION_1). A corrugated ochre plain under a star that has not moved since the world began: nothing here tracks the sun because the sun does not go anywhere; everything owns a shadow instead, or is buried, or is a giant carrying its own moving shade across a thousand kilometres of nothing.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. `workerClass` is vanilla Core's own `RimWorld.BiomeWorker_ExtremeDesert`, reused unchanged — the donor twin never carried a third-party worker class, so no `RM_BiomeWorker_Stillsand` is owed.
⛔ Star Wars canon fauna and flora do NOT ship here — Q11a (owner ruling, 2026-09-22): a genuinely canon name is IP and must route through the Utinni campaign patch layer, never the franchise-free RimMandrake tier. 13 wildAnimals rows, 3 wildPlants rows and all 5 allowedPackAnimals rows that carry Star Wars names ride src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_Stillsand.xml instead; this def ships no creature or plant rows of its own — every wild animal, plant and pack animal this biome carries in play is patched in by that file.
⚠️ One row, JOE_Cephalope, carries no RSW_/SW_/RUT_ prefix but is flagged in the item's own MEASURED STATE and routed to the same patch file anyway: its ThingDef/PawnKindDef live in src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/Defs/Absorbed_Cephaloids/Absorbed_Cephaloids_Defs.xml (Utinni tier), so wiring it inline here would give a RimMandrake-tier mod an undeclared hard dependency on Utinni content — it would not resolve on a planet with no Ash'karr loaded. STILLSAND_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 flags this as UNCERTAIN, not decided; the same is true of RSW_LightPipeNub/RSW_Ollim, the biome's own invented signature flora that per Q11a may belong in the RimMandrake tier (renamed off RSW_) rather than behind the Utinni patch — left as-is, at their current location, pending that call.
Live proof (step 5, a scratch-world quicktest with all five expansions) is Desktop-only and OWED — see the item's own verify record.
